1.0.0.description:
## Wikipelago 1.0.0

A custom Archipelago world inspired by wiki racing. Each check is a **Start → Target** round: click Wikipedia links to reach the target, collect items, and finish the **Grand Goal**.

Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7**.  
Web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/

Install `wikipelago.apworld` and this YAML from the assets below, then generate a **new** seed.

### How it plays
- Only in-article Wikipedia links count as moves
- Some rounds are open at the start; **Round Access** unlocks more
- Collect **Knowledge Fragments** to reveal the Grand Goal, a question with the answer being your final goal page. Reach it to finish the slot.

### Languages
Play on **English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, or Polish** Wikipedia (`wikipedia_language` in the YAML). The top-right dropdown only translates the client UI; it does not change which wiki you race on.

### Defaults and extras
- **Side branches** can be unlocked by reaching a crossroad and obtaining a key. They are themed target pages that you can reach simultaneously as progressing the main road.
- **Letter-pair bingo** adds boards filled with letter pais. Visit pages starting with these paris to stamp your board. Full lines count as location checks. Stamps can be found to check a nasty letter pair!
- Tools: **Back**, **Reroll**, **Search**, **Compass** can help you navigate the game, can be unlocked from the start or through the pool.
- Optional spice (off by default): deaths and deathlink, traps and traplink, sanities, hiding parts of wiki pages, Use at your own risk.

### Docs
[Overview](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/overview.md) · [Setup](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md) · [Options](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/options.md) · [FAQ](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/faq.md)

### Older rooms
The hosted client is 1.0 after this release. Old seeds should continue to work on the new client, but to stay on the old 0.6 client, run locally from tag [`0.6.0-ZaWarudo!`](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/releases/tag/v0.6.0-ZaWarudo!), see [Setup, Option 2](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md#option-2--local-client-private--vpn-rooms).

1.0.1.description:
## Wikipelago 1.0.1

Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7**. For new generates, install this `wikipelago.apworld` and YAML.
Web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/ (after VPS deploy), or local from tag `1.0.1`.

### Client
- Wrong Wiki clicks stay in the client instead of opening wikipedia.org
- Link bombs are visible: gold link text and a bomb icon to the left (still a death; still needs `deaths`)

### World
- Dropped a dead Portuguese pool title (`Rodrigo Garcia`)

Old **1.0.0** rooms keep working. Hosts generating new seeds should use this apworld.

1.0.3.description:
Requires Archipelago **0.6.7** (or compatible). Web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/

---

### Apworld / YAML

- Option Creator tooltips now match the comments in the release YAML, so a launcher-generated template reads the same as this one.

---

### Web client

**Bingo**
- Diagonal and anti-diagonal are marked with **D** / **AD** ticks.
- Larger grids keep the same cell and font size as a 5×5. You can also click the board to enlarge it.

**Journey**
- Full screen from the Journey window or pop out into its own window.

**Bug fixes**
- Reaching the Grand Goal no longer auto-sends leftover rounds. Remaining checks follow the room **Release** setting (`!release` / auto-release). The HUD updates from Archipelago’s checked locations after a release.
- Redirects and short titles now resolve to the real Wikipedia page name before a check is sent (e.g. `Task Scheduler` → `Windows Task Scheduler`).

1.1.0.description:
## Main changes

- **Topic Realms** (on by default). Every side road becomes a Realm with its own topic (History, Music, Sports…). Each Realm opens with its own Portal item instead of Branch Keys, so Realms can open in any order. Realm targets and rerolls stay on topic.
- **Realm Master goal** (`goal: realm_master`). Win by clearing every Realm. No fragments, no Grand Goal question.
- **Practice mode updated**: a 5×5 bingo board and one open Realm, each replaceable once finished.
- **Phone layout and display options**

## Improvements

- New dark and light themes, card icons, self-hosted fonts, text size selection, contrast mode, and colorblind-friendly colors.
- Notifications are now a dismissible stack at the top of the screen.
- In the Journey panel, hover a point to see the page summary, click it to open the page on Wikipedia.
- The Compass reads toward your nearest live target and updates in the background.
- Added a welcome screen before you connect, and removed made-up progress shown before connection.
- UI responds better to different horizontal and vertical resolutions.
- Bingo: Œ and Æ count as two letters (OE, AE), as in Scrabble.
- Rephrasing of certain page categories, more pages are flagged as sensitive, Grand Goal questions reworded to avoid giving the answer away.
- Large rooms: websocket messages up to 16 MB (from **mooinglemur**'s fork).

## Fixes

- DeathLink deaths and traps could apply twice in a row.
- Double-clicking a link to the target could skip a round.
- Pages that differ only by accents ("Año" / "Ano", "Bürger" / "Burger") were treated as the same page.
- A short connection drop reloaded the page, jumped to the top and used up a queued trap. Now the page stays, and a target reached while disconnected counts once the connection is back.
- The Journey pop-out window could take deaths and traps meant for the main window.
- After Practice, joining a room started on the last practice page instead of your round.
- Light theme contrast, header alignment, and missing pinyin, Vietnamese and pronunciation characters.

## For hosts and players

- Recommended Archipelago version: 0.6.7.
- Games generated with 1.0.x keep working on the updated web client.
- `topic_portals` now defaults to true, so a YAML without that line gets Realms. Set `topic_portals: false` for classic Branch Keys.
- The hosted client no longer connects to private-network addresses (localhost, LAN, Tailscale…). For those rooms, run the local client: see [Setup, Option 2](docs/setup.md#option-2--local-client-private--vpn-rooms).
- Bugs: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/issues) or the Wikipelago thread on the Archipelago Discord.

1.1.1.description:
## Main changes

- **Realm Master mode: Realms only require their Portal.** No more reaching a crossroad on the main road first. Grand Goal games are unchanged (Portal + crossroad).
- **Universal Tracker support.** UT should now behave correctly and not display unavailable Branch paths.
- **Rerolls and Backs are saved.** Used Rerolls and Backs survive reconnects and switching devices.
- **YAML option sections.** Options are sorted into a few categories in the Launcher's Options Creator for better readability.

## Improvements

- Once the main road is done, it says "Main road cleared" instead of showing the last target.
- Reduced Wikipedia requests per click.
- Article filter adjustments, and "List of…" pages are filtered in all 9 languages.
- Some Wikipedia info tables no longer show bright blue headers and now match the theme.
- The top banner can be hidden (it comes back next visit).
- Keyboard focus no longer jumps away, pop-up windows keep focus, light-theme grey text is easier to read, and loading animations respect the "reduce motion" system setting.
- The phone layout and the Journey window are now documented.
- Added a broadcast system, mostly to warn about incoming server restart.

## Bug fixes

- The click count could carry over between slots, or between Practice and a room.
- Browser Back was blocked after disconnecting; holding Backspace could spend several Backs.
- A failed teleport showed its error twice; Disconnect showed two notices.

## For hosts and players

- **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.**
- Games generated with 1.x keep working on the updated site, with their old rules.
- `random_goal_article` and `goal_article_preset` are removed. Older YAMLs that still contain them generate fine; Archipelago just logs a warning. The new YAML template requires the 1.1.1 apworld.
- Bugs: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1462007968902938768).

v0.6.0-ZaWarudo!.description:
## Wikipelago 0.6.0-ZaWarudo!

Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7**.  
**New web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/**

In-progress **0.5.x** rooms should be able to keep playing on the new client.

---

### Play in your more languages
- Seeds can use **English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, or Polish** Wikipedia
- Per-language curated article pools
- **Client UI language** is separate from the seed’s wiki language (top-right menu)
- Practice (solo) mode uses the selected UI language for its pool

### Bingo
- New item : **Progressive Bingo Stamp** allows you to stamp a cell you don't know how to get to
- Bingo boards can hide/show. First-time completion of a board auto-hides it
- Large boards better display (expand the board by clicking on it)
- Bingo letter-pair frequencies are per language (using Scrabble alphabets)

### Progression
- Surplus Knowledge Fragments option (`additional_fragments_in_pool`, default 2); required fragments default **7**

### Client performance & readability
- Faster page loads: hover prefetch + parsing and loading overlay
- Single-pass link processing / lighter search restore
- Target summary tooltip no longer clipped by the side panel
- Climate diagrams and wide tables render more reliably, fixed scrolling bugs from these tables
- Viewport-locked play area with independent side-panel scroll

### Packaging & quality
- Proper Archipelago packaging (`wikipelago.apworld`, manifest / world_version)
- YAML `requires` pins AP **0.6.7** + Wikipelago **0.6.0**
- CI builds the apworld and strict-validates all language pools
